conditions.name: Scurvy (vitamin C deficiency)
conditions.info: Guinea pigs cannot make vitamin C themselves, like people. They need it every day from fresh vegetables such as bell pepper, parsley or kale.

conditions.name: Overgrown teeth
conditions.info: A guinea pig's teeth grow all the time. Lots of hay wears them down; without it they can overgrow and hurt.

conditions.name: Bumblefoot (sore feet)
conditions.info: Dirty, wet bedding and hard floors make the soles of the feet sore and swollen. Clean, soft bedding prevents it.

conditions.name: Mites
conditions.info: Tiny mites cause itching, scratching and bald spots. A vet gives a safe treatment; never use dog or cat products.

conditions.name: Respiratory infection
conditions.info: Sneezing, crusty eyes or noisy breathing need a vet quickly. Draughts and dirty bedding make it more likely.

conditions.name: Gut stasis
conditions.info: A guinea pig's gut must keep moving. Without food for many hours it can stop – an emergency. Hay must always be there.

conditions.name: Upset tummy (too many treats)
conditions.info: Fruit and carrots are sweet. Small pieces now and then are fine; too many upset the stomach.
